selection: anchors = the hosted interactive_5_param.txt personIds (same set + order); minDate recomputed per anchor = its friends+fof (2-hop undirected knows, symmetrized, minus self) forum-membership joinDates sorted ascending, value at index floor(0.25 * len) -- a fixed low percentile so ~75% of memberships have joinDate > minDate
note: hosted interactive_5_param.txt (LDBC's own params for this graph) sets minDate too high -> no network membership joins after it -> IC5 empty + short-circuit; this regen recomputes minDate per anchor from the data. <data dir>/datasets/ is gitignored, so this tracked copy under the experiment is the source of truth; the loader prefers it.
